# Professional benchmark fixtures

These original, hand-written synthetic references and settings are shared
under the repository license. They exercise the private-manifest interface
using two public NIST corpus models, CTC01 and CTC03. The tests resolve the
manifest's `corpus` path at runtime. No model files are included here.

The models are U.S. government works distributed through the
[NIST PMI test cases](https://pages.nist.gov/CAD-PMI-Testing/models.html).
The synthetic drawings' reference statements are examples authored for these
tests.
